name: fractal
description: The Fractal Organic Operating System — persistent intelligence, adaptive workspace, agent orchestration, and real execution.

interface.shortDescription: The Organic Operating System for AI agents.
interface.longDescription: Fractal is the operating system that powers your agent with persistent memory, adaptive workspaces, and real execution capabilities. By installing this skill, your agent becomes aware of the full Fractal runtime — it can remember context across sessions, manage tasks, follow instructions, and coordinate with other agents in your workspace. Think of it as giving your agent a brain that persists, learns, and gets better over time.
defaultPrompt: Remember this context for future conversations.
Create a task to track this work and follow up on it.
Help me organize my workspace and instructions for my agents.
